nodes.label: Phase 5F Four-Region World Expansion
nodes.description: Planned expansion from the starting parish through Roscommon and Athlone to Dublin with decreasing spatial detail, new distant NPCs, and long-journey narration.

nodes.label: Cross-Region LOD Scale Validation
nodes.description: The expanded graph is intended to verify pathfinding, multi-file graph merge, tier distribution, batch throughput, and state inflation when the player reaches a distant region.

edges.description: The expansion provides the scale needed to exercise distant tier behavior and inflation.
